results.title: Insider Selling: Grocery Outlet (NASDAQ:GO) Insider Sells 1,432 Shares of Stock
results.description: Grocery Outlet Holding Corp. (NASDAQ:GO – Get Free Report) insider Frank Michael Kerr sold 1,432 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Friday, August 21st.
